interpretation.text:
On 2026-11-04, QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H was 0.50001, near the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5—not proof of independence. R²=0.979 describes fit quality only over the 12 supplied scales, spanning 8–63 observations. H rose 0.0156/0.0284 over 1/5 observations. Its prior-only, 30-estimate standardized deviation was +1.87; overlapping windows make this no significance test.

The separate 1,000-observation Hill window gives alpha=3.309, using k=100 tails above x_min=0.01996 absolute log-return units. Conditional on a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher suggests thinner tails. Using 5%/15% cutoffs gives 3.576/3.074: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

From 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-04, H fluctuated upward from 0.4543 to 0.50001; alpha fell from 3.578 to 3.309. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
